pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- Working directory persists between calls, but prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

content.text:
The fix list from round 1 is fully applied. `npm test` passed: 485 of 485, 0 skipped, about 6.3 s. I only ran it once because a second run to check for flakiness was denied. What's left is small: a few duplicated literals, one unused helper, short names in the HTML parser, and two assertions that check "not empty" where the spec fixes the exact message.

**Round-1 fixes, all confirmed**
- **Shared helpers:** `assertJsonError`, `listBookings`, `useServer`, `withTempDir`, `withServer`, `freshBooking` and `label` now live in `test/helpers/api-assert.mjs`, and `assertOnlyAllowedApis` and `cancelButtons` in `test/helpers/fake-dom.mjs`. `postWith` is gone.
- **Exact success-status tests:** POST answered with 200 or 204 (app-actions:137-155); GET answered with 201 (startup-list:64, 146) or 204 (74, 81, 165); DELETE answered with 200 or 201 (app-actions:222-236).
- **Cancel 404/500:** the button is checked to be enabled again (app-actions:217).
- **Page text:** compared exactly, with no trim.
- **Port tests:** `startOnZeroPrefixedFreePort` retries up to 5 times, and the port-3000 test gives a skip reason.
- **Test names:** `label()` escapes invisible characters as `\u{..}`, and the names I checked are unique.
- **Persistence helpers:** `exists()` rethrows anything that isn't ENOENT, and the abort error handler has its comment.
- **TextNode:** checked with `instanceof TextNode` (startup-list:110, fake-dom:39).
- **Cleanup:** temp dirs and child processes are removed in `finally` blocks everywhere, and `stop()` is safe to call twice.

**Remaining issues (minor)**
1. **Duplication:** `ROOMS` is exported from `api-assert.mjs:8` but nothing imports it. The room list is still written out by hand in 5 test-file places, plus the startup reply in `fake-dom.mjs:194`.
2. **Duplication:** the "POST reply" test in `api-routing.test.mjs` (lines 134-143) repeats what `assertCreated` and `SIX_KEYS` already check. Separately, its test at lines 72-74 repeats the `GET /api/bookings/abc` case already covered by the loop at line 58.
3. **Unused code:** `rawRequest` in `server-harness.mjs:142` is exported but never used.
4. **Weak assertions:** three tests only check that `#error` is not empty for a 204 reply with an unreadable body. A 204 is never treated as "no reply", so the spec gives exactly `Request failed.`. A wrong version that shows `Could not reach the server.` would still pass.
5. **Naming:** `html-tree.mjs` and the parser self-tests use one-letter names (`m`, `n`, `c`, `r`, `s`, `w`, `i`, `cur`).

## GRADE
Overall: 9/10
Verdict: pass
structure: 9 — focused helpers and test files, one job each, setup and cleanup centralised in `useServer`/`withServer`/`withTempDir`
naming: 8 — test and helper names are clear, but html-tree.mjs and the parser self-tests use one-letter names
duplication: 8 — round-1 copies are gone, but the room list is still written out 5 times, the routing POST test repeats `assertCreated`, and one 405 case is tested twice
size: 10 — every file is under 300 lines and every function is well under 50
errors: 9 — `exists()` rethrows, startup errors are re-thrown on purpose, the abort handler is commented, and processes are killed in `finally`
tests: 9 — wide coverage of the rules with tests that catch plausible wrong versions (UTF-16 units vs code points, trim vs trimEnd, `<` vs `<=`, the earliest overlap), but three 204 checks accept any non-empty message
security: 10 — no secrets, temp dirs only, the child env is built clean
leftovers: 8 — no console.log or TODOs, but the `rawRequest` and `ROOMS` exports are never used
Fixes:
- /root/bench-runs/h4-c3e12a23/test/app-startup-list.test.mjs:7 import `ROOMS` from a shared helper instead of redefining it; use it in api-routing.test.mjs:28, server-persistence.test.mjs:232, page-html.test.mjs:109 and fake-dom.mjs:194
- /root/bench-runs/h4-c3e12a23/test/api-routing.test.mjs:134 replace the POST reply body with `assertCreated(res, value)`
- /root/bench-runs/h4-c3e12a23/test/api-routing.test.mjs:72 delete the separate `GET /api/bookings/abc` test; the loop at line 58 already covers it
- /root/bench-runs/h4-c3e12a23/test/helpers/server-harness.mjs:142 remove the unused `rawRequest` export (and the `connect` import)
- /root/bench-runs/h4-c3e12a23/test/app-startup-list.test.mjs:77 assert `errorText(page) === 'Request failed.'` instead of `notEqual ''`
- /root/bench-runs/h4-c3e12a23/test/app-actions.test.mjs:148 assert exactly `'Request failed.'` for the 204 case as well (drop the `notEqual` plus the 200-only exact check)
- /root/bench-runs/h4-c3e12a23/test/helpers/html-tree.mjs:4-92 rename `m`/`n`/`c`/`r`/`cur`/`i` to descriptive names (`match`, `node`, `child`, `result`, `current`, `index`)
